title: Analysis of the $1.89 Trillion Leisure and Hospitality Construction Projects Market, Q3 2024 - Data on the Top 20 Projects per Region by Country, Stage, and Value of Projects
description: The report provides analysis on the $1.89 trillion leisure and hospitality construction projects pipeline, with the largest overall pipeline in North America. The pipeline comprises hotel and resort projects as well as mixed-use developments with a significant leisure and hospitality component.
